# Data Card: IdentityGraph synthetic applications

**Synthetic.** Generated by `src/identitygraph/data/generator.py` (seeded, default seed 42, 20,000 rows over 240 days from 2025-01-01).
No real people, identities or transactions. Names/emails/phones/addresses are fabricated; domains are `*.test`.

## Scenarios (labels: `fraud_label` 1 = simulated fraud)
legitimate (incl. noisy shared households, odd emails, some high credit ratios), synthetic_identity, device_ring,
shared_contact, velocity_burst, identity_inconsistency, income_anomaly. Target fraud rate 7% overall
(the chronological test period contains 9.4% because fraud clusters fall unevenly in time).

## Columns
See `data/synthetic/data_dictionary.json` (written by `scripts/generate_data.py`) and `src/identitygraph/data/schemas.py`.
`fraud_label` and `fraud_scenario` are **training-only** and are rejected by the scoring API.

## Known caveats
- Fraud patterns are simulated with explicit signals, so models score better than they would on real fraud.
- Legitimate noise is modest; real-world overlap is larger.
- IEEE-CIS (Kaggle) data is NOT used. It labels transaction fraud, not synthetic-identity fraud, and must be kept separate if added.
